title: A quotient of a strictly henselian local ring by a proper ideal is strictly henselian (Stacks 05WS for a strictly henselian ring)
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ be an ideal. Then $A/I$ is a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m/I$ and residue field $\kappa$, and $A/I$ is strictly henselian: for every finite $A/I$-algebra $B$ every idempotent of $B/(\mathfrak m/I)B$ lifts uniquely to an idempotent of $B$, and $\kappa$ is separably closed.

source.place: Lemma 05WS (label lemma-quotient-strict-henselization), line 43703 ($R^{sh}/IR^{sh}$ is a strict henselization of $R/I$), applied as in etale-cohomology.tex Lemma 09ZC (line 14445) proof to a strictly henselian $R$ (so $R^{sh}=R$); direct route: a finite $A/I$-algebra $B$ is a finite $A$-algebra with $B/\mathfrak mB=B/(\mathfrak m/I)B$, so the idempotent lifting of Definition 04GE/04GF transfers

proof.text: Since I is contained in the maximal ideal it is proper. Mathlib quotient nontriviality and the surjective-image local-ring theorem give the local structure; map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective identifies the maximal ideal.

The quotient map induces a ring map on residue fields. It is injective because its source is a field, and surjective by lifting first through the target residue map and then through the quotient map. RingEquiv.ofBijective gives an equivalence; its inverse commutes with reduction by symm_apply_apply.

Apply henselianRing_quotient_maximalIdeal and rewrite the image maximal ideal using step 1. Its simple-root lifting gives HenselianLocalRing by mapping the derivative unit into the residue quotient. Transfer separable closedness along the residue equivalence to construct IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing.

Every module-finite algebra over the quotient is integral. Apply the existing unique idempotent-lifting theorem for integral algebras to the quotient maximal-ideal henselian pair. Combine this with the local structure, compatible residue equivalence, strict henselianity, and separable closedness of the original residue field.

lean.statement: theorem isStrictlyHenselianLocalRing_quotient (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] (hA : IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing A) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) : ∃ (_ : IsLocalRing (A ⧸ I)), IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I) = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ∧ (∃ e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (A ⧸ I) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField A, ∀ a : A, e (IsLocalRing.residue (A ⧸ I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a)) = IsLocalRing.residue A a) ∧ IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing (A ⧸ I) ∧ IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ∧ ∀ (B : Type (max u v)) [CommRing B] [Algebra (A ⧸ I) B] [Module.Finite (A ⧸ I) B], ∀ e : B ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I)).map (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) B), IsIdempotentElem e → ∃! b : B, IsIdempotentElem b ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A ⧸ I)).map (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) B)) b = e
